equations.expression: P_p(X=x)=Comb(n,x)p^x(1-p)^(n-x), 0<=x<=n
equations.meaning: 二项抽样概率质量函数

equations.expression: min n subject to 1-F(n,r-1;p0)<=alpha and 1-F(n,r-1;p_alt)>=1-beta
equations.meaning: 拒收方案精确约束与最小样本量

equations.expression: min n subject to F(n,c;p0)>=1-alpha_accept; ties choose largest c
equations.meaning: 接收方案精确约束与最小样本量

equations.expression: L_accept(p)=F(n,c;p); L_reject(p)=F(n,r-1;p)
equations.meaning: 两情形接收概率函数

equations.expression: log LR=x log(p_alt/p0)+(n-x)log((1-p_alt)/(1-p0)); accept below a, reject above b, truncate at n_fixed
equations.meaning: 有限SPRT边界与截断规则

equations.expression: E_p[N_SPRT]=sum_{j=0}^{n_fixed-1}P(N_SPRT>j); choose SPRT iff exact tails pass and both E_p0 and E_palt are no larger
equations.meaning: 固定样本与有限SPRT同约束比较

equations.expression: h=(h1,h2), h_i in {empty,good,bad}; terminal states contain no outstanding demand
equations.meaning: 问题2即时回流状态

equations.expression: z_i=0: A_i(empty)=a_i and A_i(good,bad)=0; z_i=1: A_i(good)=t_i and A_i(empty,bad)=t_i+(a_i+t_i)/(1-p_i)
equations.meaning: 零配件准备成本与去向

equations.expression: P_bad=1-I(h1=good)I(h2=good)(1-pf)
equations.meaning: 装配不合格的两类来源

equations.expression: V_pi(h)=E_pi[immediate cash reward+1_not_terminal V_pi(h')], V_pi(terminal)=0
equations.meaning: 含检测、调换和回流的状态方程

equations.expression: V_pi(empty)=E[r_market N_market-a-parts-t-inspection-k_f N_assembly-g_dis N_disassembly-L_exchange N_return]
equations.meaning: 逐轮现金流守恒账本

equations.expression: Pi2*=max over (Z1,Z2,C,D) in {0,1}^4 of V_pi(empty), excluding nonabsorbing policies
equations.meaning: 问题2策略空间与argmax

equations.expression: P_bad(v)=1-[product over parents I(parent good)](1-p_v)
equations.meaning: 一般装配节点的不合格率

equations.expression: P_pi(h,h') and r_pi(h,h') are generated by procurement, inspection, assembly, sale, scrap and disassembly events
equations.meaning: 一般网络的现金事件转移核

equations.expression: V_pi(h)=r_pi(h)+sum_h' P_pi(h,h')V_pi(h'); V_pi(h)=0 after one qualified root delivery
equations.meaning: 全事件闭环价值递推

equations.expression: Q_v=lim E[N_good,v]/E[N_launch,v], C_v=lim E[cash cost,v]/E[N_launch,v], U_v=C_v/Q_v
equations.meaning: 产出率、投入成本率及单位合格成本

equations.expression: Pi3=(E[r_market N_market]-E[L_exchange N_return]-C_root)/Q_root
equations.meaning: 一般网络单位合格交付利润

equations.expression: abs(Pi2_pi-Pi3_deg_pi)<=cashflow_abs_tol for every one of the 16 degenerate policies
equations.meaning: 问题3退化实例与问题2逐策略等价

equations.expression: p_hat_v=x_v/n_v, 0<=x_v<=n_v and n_v>=1
equations.meaning: 抽样点估计

equations.expression: L_v=0 if x_v=0 else QBeta(alpha/2;x_v,n_v-x_v+1); U_CI_v=1 if x_v=n_v else QBeta(1-alpha/2;x_v+1,n_v-x_v)
equations.meaning: 含端点分支的Clopper-Pearson区间

equations.expression: B_joint=product_v[L_v,U_CI_v], alpha_joint=alpha_family/M
equations.meaning: Bonferroni联合置信域

equations.expression: n_v=min{n in 1..n_max: width_CP(p_v,n)<=w_target}
equations.meaning: 逐节点精度样本量设计

equations.expression: x_v^(b)~Binomial(n_v,p_v^scenario); p_hat_v^(b)=x_v^(b)/n_v; theta_v^(b)~Beta(x_v^(b)+1/2,n_v-x_v^(b)+1/2)
equations.meaning: 可复现情景抽样与后验重抽样

equations.expression: Pi_low(pi)=min over theta in B_joint Pi(pi,theta); rho_decision=mean I[pi*(p_hat^(b))=pi*(p_scenario)]
equations.meaning: 最坏情景利润与决策一致率
